---
name: Bug report
about: Something in a skill is wrong, broken, or misleading
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Which skill / file?**
(e.g., `mri-reconstruction`, or `references/recon-methods.md`)

**What's wrong?**
A clear description — a broken link, an incorrect citation, a command that
doesn't work, a rotted URL, etc.

**Expected**
What it should say or do.

**Environment (if relevant)**
Agent (Claude Code / Codex / …), OS, and tool versions (BART, SigPy, …).
